name: SHV Schweizerischer Hängegleiter-Verband
tagline: Swiss free flight federation promoting hang gliding and paragliding
hero_kpi_rationale: En tant qu'organisation à but non lucratif engagée dans la durabilité environnementale, les émissions de CO2 constituent un indicateur clé aligné avec la stratégie de la fédération. L'empreinte carbone de 234 tonnes CO2-équivalent en 2023 reflète les engagements environnementaux et climatiques de la FSVL.

kpis.explanation: Total greenhouse gas emissions measured in CO2 equivalent tonnes from direct operations including headquarters, board, and elite sports.
kpis.signal: Organization actively tracking and offsetting carbon footprint through Swiss Olympic Climate Fund
kpis.description: CO2 balance calculated for 2023 covering all direct GHG emissions from FSVL headquarters, board activities, and elite sports programs. Mobility accounts for approximately 73% of emissions (170 tonnes), with international flight travel for competitions representing approximately 90 tonnes. Material consumption (primarily Swiss Glider magazine printing) contributes approximately 60 tonnes.

kpis.explanation: CO2 emissions from international air travel for elite sports competitions and athlete examinations.
kpis.signal: Approximately 39% of total emissions from flight activities, primarily elite sports participation
kpis.description: International flight emissions for 2023 primarily from elite sport athletes participating in international competitions. Offset through Swiss Olympic Climate Fund (CHF 9,000 contribution).

kpis.explanation: Total CO2 emissions from all mobility activities including staff commuting, athlete travel, and board activities.
kpis.signal: Largest emissions driver representing 73% of total organizational footprint
kpis.description: Mobility constitutes the primary emissions source for 2023, comprising international flight travel (approximately 90 tonnes), pilot examination travel (approximately 80 tonnes), and staff commuting. Represents dominant opportunity for emission reduction.

kpis.explanation: CO2 emissions from material consumption, primarily from printing and distribution of organizational publications.
kpis.signal: Second largest emissions driver representing 26% of total emissions, concentrated in Swiss Glider magazine production
kpis.description: Material consumption emissions for 2023 driven predominantly by Swiss Glider federation magazine printing (approximately 50 tonnes CO2-eq). Represents secondary optimization opportunity.

kpis.explanation: Annual financial contributions distributed for volunteer service activities and environmental projects.
kpis.signal: Consistent volunteer support funding, stabilized around CHF 5,000 after 2022 peak
kpis.description: Volunteer contributions distributed in 2024 amount to CHF 5,440 (as of 28.10.2024). Historical trend shows 2020: CHF 700, 2021: CHF 2,635, 2022: CHF 10,000 (peak), 2023: CHF 5,505, 2024: CHF 5,440. Reflects ongoing commitment to environmental stewardship and community engagement.

kpis.explanation: Annual budget allocated through club support fund for site management and infrastructure projects.
kpis.signal: Direct financial support for club operations and takeoff and landing site infrastructure
kpis.description: In 2024, nine projects received support through the club fund totaling CHF 20,000. Funds support clubs and flight schools managing takeoff and landing sites across Switzerland.

ai_positioning.summary: L'organisation ne mentionne aucune stratégie, technologie ou initiative liée à l'intelligence artificielle. Ses activités se concentrent sur la promotion du vol libre, la gestion environnementale, la protection de la faune et l'organisation de compétitions d'élite.
evidence: Aucune mention de l'IA dans le rapport annuel 2024
Absence de projets technologiques ou numériques avancés
Focus sur l'environnement, la sécurité, la coordination associative et les études écologiques
